# The clock's minute hand: a navy bar 0.42 long pointing up from the clock's centre (0, 3.75, -3.16),
# its origin at the centre (the pivot). The game ticks it round. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Hand --base-color 0.1216 0.1412 0.2941 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Hand --size 1 --location 0.000 3.150 3.945
scale 0.080 0.060 0.450
apply --scale
material assign Hand
active Hand
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
cursor set 0 3.15 3.75
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
shade flat
export hand.glb
